name: AnyModelBot
cost: Free app (MIT). Models are pay per use through a Modelflare account
works_with: Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker; WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Slack, Discord
short: A local-first app for your own AI bots on GPT, Claude, Gemini and 70+ models, reachable from chat apps and able to run tasks in the background.
what: Each bot has its own persona, default model, workspace and memory. You chat with it in the app or from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Slack or Discord, and it can read and write files, run commands, operate your desktop and run scheduled rules in the background. Every model comes through Modelflare, a paid gateway, and conversations, memory, files and keys stay on your device.
who: People who want an always-on personal AI agent they run themselves, with one bill across many models. Skip it if you want to use your own provider keys directly, since models come from Modelflare.
needs: For Docker: a NAS or server with Docker
To build from source: Node.js 22.13+ and Go 1.26.8+

steps.title: Download the app
steps.text: Pick the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from the releases page: https://github.com/modelflare-ai/AnyModelBot/releases. On Linux, `chmod +x` the AppImage and run it.

steps.title: Check the download
steps.text: Compare it with the line in the release's `SHA256SUMS`. On macOS use `shasum -a 256 <file>`.

steps.title: Sign in to Modelflare
steps.text: The first launch opens your browser to sign in or sign up. The app then connects itself, so there is no key to copy.

steps.title: Or run it in Docker
steps.code:
docker run -d --name amb -p 3600:3600 -v amb-data:/data ghcr.io/modelflare-ai/anymodel-bot
docker exec amb cat /data/ui-token

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Every morning at 8, check X's price and tell me if it drops below 200." Say "observe first" to see what it would do before it acts.

watch: Model requests go through Modelflare to the provider you pick, and Modelflare keeps request logs. Its Trust Center says what is kept and for how long.
Bots can run commands and operate your desktop. Computer use runs automatically by default; switch a bot to ask before changing the screen if you want to approve each action.
Image and video generation asks first only above an estimated 0.50 US dollars. Tasks and rules have default budgets you can change.
Task folders unused for 30 days are deleted without asking unless you press Keep.
Don't expose port 3600 directly to the internet.
